acceptance.archive_and_reference_rules: PASS — manual rows reuse the existing job_descriptions lifecycle (archive/delete/reference checks were shipped in #100/#099 and require no source-specific changes; confirmed via lifecycle test suite)
acceptance.tests_cover_sparse_complete_invalid_dupl: PASS — 15 unit + 6 integration tests cover sparse (nulls/empty lists), complete (provenance/confidence/evidence), invalid (blank title, bounds, bad employment_type), duplicate (hash equality + duplicate_pending + allow_duplicate)

implementation_notes: DraftItem.critical added to the RIP-011 review schema: Pydantic silently dropped unknown JSONB keys, which would have lost manual critical flags through save_review_draft/publish round trips; the roundtrip unit test caught this before shipping
RequiredSkill.name now bounded max_length=500 matching ExtractedSkill; matching code paths construct names from already-bounded extraction output so no behavior change

Duplicate detection for manual entries runs inline in create_manual (not the worker pipeline, which manual rows never enter); duplicate_pending rows can still be confirmed/cancelled through the existing /duplicate/confirm and /duplicate/cancel endpoints (confirm dispatches the LLM extraction pipeline like text entries)
API response for POST /jd/import/manual uses the JobDescriptionData projection (review_draft omitted); the detail endpoint returns the full draft for the review editor
residual_risks: Frontend manual mode was implemented in #104 (import dialog tab, types, i18n); #105 will finish the remaining image-mode UI and five-mode acceptance with browser checks deferred per reviews/20260805-browser-acceptance-waiver.md

reviews.note: manual creation is synchronous and evidence-honest: provenance=manual, confidence=1.0, no fabricated quotes, no LLM call; inline user-scoped duplicate detection mirrors worker semantics; DraftItem.critical added so manual skill weight survives the review/publish round trip (roundtrip test caught silent Pydantic key-drop)
